title: Query stored log records
body:
Agents need to read Cardinal's logs without opening the database. Add `cardinal logs query`.

- R1: Prints one JSON line per stored record, oldest first, shaped `{"seq": <int>, "record": <LogRecord>}`, where `seq` is the record's position in the store and `record` matches `cardinal logs schema`.
- R2: `--level L` keeps records at L or more severe (debug < info < warning < error < critical); `--repo owner/name` keeps records whose `source.repo` matches; `--fingerprint F` keeps records with that fingerprint. Filters combine.
- R3: `--after-seq N` keeps records with `seq` greater than N; `--limit K` prints at most K lines, the oldest K that match.
- R4: An unknown `--level` exits 2 with a JSON error on stderr and prints nothing on stdout.

Add end-to-end tests that drive the CLI.
